summary.archetypeConfidenceDescription: Shows how strongly the analyzer believes the detected archetype matches the deck card signals.

archetypeReasons.generic: This plan is supported by the strongest card-role patterns found in the deck.
archetypeReasons.mixed: No single plan clearly dominates; the deck has meaningful support for more than one game plan.
archetypeReasons.combo: The deck has combo lines, tutors, compact win conditions, or enough combo pieces to make a combo plan credible.
archetypeReasons.aristocrats: The deck has sacrifice outlets, sacrifice payoffs, token makers, or recursion that work together as an aristocrats engine.
archetypeReasons.reanimator: The deck has ways to fill the graveyard, reanimate threats, and bring back cards worth cheating into play.
archetypeReasons.control: The deck has enough interaction, sweepers, counterspells, and card flow to support a control game plan.
archetypeReasons.stax: The deck includes tax or stax pieces that can restrict opponents while its own plan keeps functioning.
archetypeReasons.blink: The deck has blink enablers and enter-the-battlefield payoffs that can generate repeated value.
archetypeReasons.tokens: The deck can create tokens and has payoffs or finishers that turn those bodies into pressure.
archetypeReasons.typal: The deck is built around a shared creature type with enough matching creatures or tribal support.
archetypeReasons.voltron_infect: The deck has protection, combat pressure, equipment, auras, or infect-style threats that support a single attacker plan.
archetypeReasons.spellslinger: The deck has instant and sorcery density, card selection, cost reduction, or burst mana for a spellslinger plan.
archetypeReasons.artifact: The deck has enough artifacts or artifact payoffs for artifacts to be a central theme.
archetypeReasons.enchantress: The deck has enough enchantments or enchantment payoffs for enchantments to be a central theme.
archetypeReasons.landfall: The deck has landfall cards or land-search support that rewards repeated land drops.
archetypeReasons.theft: The deck has theft effects that make opponents' cards part of its plan.
archetypeReasons.discard: The deck has discard effects or payoffs that reward making players discard cards.
archetypeReasons.mill: The deck has mill effects or payoffs that make milling a meaningful path.
archetypeReasons.lifegain: The deck has lifegain cards or payoffs that turn life gain into material advantage.

mana.title: Mana Analysis
mana.fetchlandsNotTutors: Fetchlands are analyzed as mana fixing, not generic tutors.
mana.unavailable: Mana analysis is not available for this deck.

boardWipes.title: Board Wipe Analysis
boardWipes.unavailable: Board wipe analysis is not available for this deck.

low_hard_board_wipes.title: Few hard board wipes
low_hard_board_wipes.message: Hard board wipe count is below the expected baseline for this plan.

wipes_are_mostly_bounce_or_conditional.title: Wipes are mostly soft or conditional
wipes_are_mostly_bounce_or_conditional.message: Mass bounce, pseudo-wipes, and conditional wipes are separated from hard resets.

wipes_are_mostly_pseudo.title: Wipes are mostly pseudo-wipes
wipes_are_mostly_pseudo.message: The wipe count is mostly pseudo, combat-only, or conditional rather than reliable hard resets.

wipes_are_mostly_bounce.title: Wipes are mostly bounce
wipes_are_mostly_bounce.message: The wipe package leans on mass bounce and has little hard creature reset coverage.

no_indestructible_answer.title: No wipe answers indestructible
no_indestructible_answer.message: The deck has wipes, but none are classified as exile, sacrifice, -X/-X, tuck, or shuffle answers.

no_artifact_enchantment_wipe_coverage.title: No artifact or enchantment wipe coverage
no_artifact_enchantment_wipe_coverage.message: The wipe package has no mass artifact or enchantment coverage.

no_graveyard_wipe_coverage.title: No graveyard wipe coverage
no_graveyard_wipe_coverage.message: The wipe package has no graveyard exile coverage for plans where that can matter.

too_many_symmetrical_wipes_for_creature_.title: Too many symmetrical wipes for a creature plan
too_many_symmetrical_wipes_for_creature_.message: Several wipes can reset the deck own creature board.

own_plan_collision_wipes.title: Wipes collide with the deck plan
own_plan_collision_wipes.message: Some wipes overlap with the deck own permanent, graveyard, artifact, enchantment, token, or creature plan.

board_wipes_self_plan_risk.title: Board wipes may pressure the deck plan
board_wipes_self_plan_risk.message: Some wipes overlap with the deck own permanent strategy.

expensive_wipe_package.title: Wipe package is expensive
expensive_wipe_package.message: Most wipes cost six or more mana and no low-cost emergency wipe is classified.

no_cheap_emergency_wipe.title: No cheap emergency wipe
no_cheap_emergency_wipe.message: The deck has wipes, but none are classified as efficient low-cost emergency resets.

overload_wipe_available.title: Overload wipe available
overload_wipe_available.message: At least one wipe has an alternative mass mode such as overload.

asymmetrical_wipe_strength.title: Asymmetrical wipe strength
asymmetrical_wipe_strength.message: The deck has one-sided or asymmetrical board wipe coverage.

modal_wipe_strength.title: Modal wipe strength
modal_wipe_strength.message: The deck has flexible modal board wipe coverage.

opponent_compensation_risk.title: Opponent compensation risk
opponent_compensation_risk.message: Some wipes can compensate opponents by ramping or replacing resources.
